title: Pac-Man
description: Eat the dots and avoid the ghosts in this retro arcade classic.
about:
Pac-Man is a browser game where you guide Pac-Man through the maze, collect dots and avoid ghosts. Eat a power pellet to turn the tables for a short time.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Guide Pac-Man through the maze, collect dots and avoid ghosts. Eat a power pellet to turn the tables for a short time.
tips: Use arrow keys to move through the maze.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play Pac-Man?
faq.answer: Guide Pac-Man through the maze, collect dots and avoid ghosts. Eat a power pellet to turn the tables for a short time.

faq.question: Can I play Pac-Man in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.
